title: Bounds for a probability expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $g:\Omega\to\bbr$ satisfy $0\le g(x)\le 1$ for every $x\in\Omega$. Then the expectation of $g$ under $p$ lies in $[0,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
